purpose: Create an original, identity-lockable alien Critic called Veyra for the EVAVO Council before any animation production begins.

views.label: full body slight right three-quarter
views.prompt: Eye-level full-body presentation, slight right three-quarter orientation, complete cranial sail, four eyes, both four-digit hands and both feet visible, calm grounded posture and no dramatic perspective.

views.label: full body slight left three-quarter
views.prompt: Same exact alien elder and garments from a slight left three-quarter orientation, eye level, complete silhouette, all four eyes and both four-digit hands clearly readable.

views.label: neutral identity bust
views.prompt: Neutral chest-up identity view of the same exact alien elder, calm direct four-eyed gaze, cranial-sail attachment and face planes clear enough for strict continuity review.

style.lock: EVAVO-crafted editorial creature design with premium creative-studio art direction. Veyra is an original adult alien tribunal elder with an extremely tall narrow silhouette, four independently readable eyes arranged as two restrained pairs, a sculptural vertical cranial sail, bone-white skin with subtle mineral variation, and long controlled four-digit hands. Garments are black mineral-textured ceremonial work layers with practical construction and one faded Council-red seam. The presence is precise and formidable but never villain-coded, monstrous, cute, glossy or generic. Materials should feel authored and tactile, like a carefully built practical creature interpreted through EVAVO's restrained black, off-white and cherry-red language.
style.continuity: Every view in a candidate set must show the same exact species design, age, four-eye placement, pupil shape, face planes, cranial-sail height and attachment, ear or breathing structures, bone-white skin pattern, four-digit hand anatomy, garment construction, red seam placement, proportions, handedness, feet, baseline and material language. Do not redesign, humanise or mutate the anatomy between views.
mustHave: one complete original adult alien tribunal elder named Veyra
exactly four independently readable eyes in the same registered arrangement
one tall sculptural cranial sail with a stable silhouette and attachment
two stable long hands with exactly four digits per hand
bone-white skin with restrained mineral variation rather than glow
black mineral-textured ceremonial work garments with believable construction
one faded Council-red seam or construction insert
calm precise intelligent expression without villain coding
strong narrow full-body silhouette distinct from EVA, Top Hat Man and Moro Pell
genuine transparent background with no scene, shadow plate or checkerboard
mustAvoid: human woman, human bob haircut or ordinary human facial anatomy
villain, demon, undead, horror-monster or evil character coding
protected fictional creature reconstruction or recognisable franchise imitation
cyberpunk neon, sci-fi glow, glowing eyes or glossy game-character rendering
holograms or floating user interface elements
robot parts, headsets, futuristic armour, weapons or tactical gear
Top Hat Man hat, moustache, cane or historical tailoring
Moro Pell broad amphibious body, three eyes or throat membrane
extra eyes, missing eyes, unstable digit count or changing cranial-sail geometry
logos, readable text, watermark, scenery, contact sheet or checkerboard transparency
cropped cranial sail, hands, digits, feet or garment hem
style.originality: Create a new EVAVO-owned alien Critic identity from this direction. Do not reconstruct, imitate or closely derive any protected fictional character, celebrity, stock mascot, existing game alien or existing AI-assistant character. The result must read as one deliberately art-directed EVAVO Council elder rather than a recognisable external archetype.
